instrumentDefectFound.severity: high -- blocks this lane's own completion predicate AND every other OPS-21 lane's (S1, S2, D1-D6, PROGRAM all share the same broken helper)
instrumentDefectFound.file: doc_repo scripts/plan-progress.mjs (NOT hauska-factory -- out of this lane's write scope; reporting only, per AGENT_CONTRACT 'stay in your own repository' and DEV_PROCESS 5.4 'propose, do not unilaterally remediate')
instrumentDefectFound.defect: unaccountedIn()'s WHERE clause reads `c.cell_state = 'unaccounted'`. parcel_record_cell.cell_state is jsonb (confirmed live: information_schema.columns data_type=jsonb). Comparing a jsonb column to the bare string literal 'unaccounted' makes Postgres attempt `'unaccounted'::jsonb`, which is not valid JSON (an unquoted bare word) -- every predicate built by unaccountedIn() (S1, S2, D1, D3, D4) plus the inline D2 and PROGRAM predicates throws `invalid input syntax for type json` (code 22P02) at runtime. D6's `c.cell_state <> 'available-on-request'` has the identical defect.
instrumentDefectFound.liveProof: Ran the D1 predicate's exact generated SQL against FACTORY_DATABASE_URL_RO (read-only) this session: `QUERY FAILED: invalid input syntax for type json 22P02`. Every other read of cell_state in this codebase (cell-state.js, liveness.js's RAIL_LIVENESS_SQL, ingest-existing.js, parcel-r5-zoning.mjs's UPDATE_ZONING_CELLS_SQL) consistently uses `cell_state->>'kind'`, confirming this is the actual, established, correct access pattern and unaccountedIn() is the outlier.
instrumentDefectFound.blastRadiusIsBounded: plan-progress.mjs's own runtime (main(), not --sql or --self-test) wraps each query in try/catch and reports status 'UNMEASURED' on any thrown error rather than treating the exception as a false zero -- so this does NOT silently report DONE. It fails loud in the sense the file's own header promises. But every lane depending on 'node scripts/plan-progress.mjs' (no flag) to state whether its predicate is met currently sees UNMEASURED for all 8 ledger predicates, not a real number -- the exact 'first plan in this operation whose completion is machine-checkable' claim (OPS-16 amendment A-122) is not true today.
instrumentDefectFound.selfTestBlindSpot: selfTest()'s own NON-VACUITY check only asserts the SQL STRING contains the substring 'cell_state' (`p.sql.includes('cell_state')`), which is true for the broken query too -- the self-test cannot catch this class of defect because it never executes the SQL against a real schema. DEV_PROCESS 2.2: 'a gating indicator is tested for its ability to FIRE before it is trusted' -- this self-test does not fire the predicate at all.
instrumentDefectFound.proposedFix: In unaccountedIn(), change `AND c.cell_state = 'unaccounted'` to `AND c.cell_state->>'kind' = 'unaccounted'`. In D2's inline SQL, same change. In D6's inline SQL, change `c.cell_state <> 'available-on-request'` to `c.cell_state->>'kind' <> 'available-on-request'`. Strengthening selfTest() to actually execute against a live or fixture schema (or at minimum assert the exact substring `cell_state->>'kind'`) would close the blind spot per DEV_PROCESS 2.2/2.4.
instrumentDefectFound.notFixedHere: doc_repo commits are planner-owned (AGENT_CONTRACT section 6); this lane's write scope is hauska-factory only. Verification of THIS lane's own numbers below was done with hand-written SQL using the correct `->>'kind'` pattern, not by trusting the broken helper.
